desc: The LAR-15 Coyote Rifle AR15 features an RRA A2 fixed stock a flat top optic-ready upper and a Hogue rubber pistol grip. It features a RRA Rifle Length Deluxe Extended Freefloat Handguard that includes 3 small accessory rails. It has Rock River's excellent two stage match trigger and an oversized winter trigger guard for gloved hands on cold weather hunts.
